decisions.reason: ios/P1/overview: The complete supplied title is visible in natural multiline flow, with its final word and no ellipsis.
ios/P1/overview: The supplied destination and temperature string, including the final temperature unit, is visible without truncation; the narrow case wraps naturally.
ios/P1/overview: The entire current status string is legible inside the band; line breaks preserve all words.
ios/P1/overview: The current Review/Hide handling label is completely visible without an ellipsis.
ios/P1/overview: The full current confirmation label is visible beside the check square; narrow layouts wrap it without dropping words.
ios/P1/overview: The full Release transfer/Requested label is visible and centered, without truncation.
ios/P1/overview: Across the state images, content stays within the component sides. Cropping at the viewport top/bottom is ordinary parent scrolling; overlapping frames expose the text there.
ios/P1/overview: Successive text rows and controls have visible separation across the state. No glyphs or surfaces overlap adjacent rows.
ios/P1/overview: The images show accent, title, subtitle, status, disclosure, then any notes, choice and primary in that vertical reading order.
ios/P1/overview: The main blocks align in one vertical column; the check square and its label remain one choice row.
ios/P1/overview: The pale painted canvas extends to both offered component edges inside the host gutters, around the white surface. The external host region is excluded.
ios/P1/overview: The closed state proceeds from disclosure to choice and primary; no handling-note heading is visible.
ios/P1/overview: The closed state proceeds from disclosure to choice and primary; no handling-note body paragraph is visible.
ios/P1/overview: The visible band has straight horizontal/vertical edges and four square corners.
ios/P1/overview: The status surface is a flat fill with no visible outline stroke.

ios/P1/overview: The primary fill has no visible outline stroke.
ios/P1/overview: The fully exposed primary painted rectangle meets its observed native control boundary on all sides; no uncovered strip is visible.
ios/P1/overview: The solid accent is a vertical rectangle with four square corners.
